On this page

Best Model

This award is for teams who build a model of their system and use it to inform system design or simulate expected behavior before, or in conjunction with, experiments in the wet lab.

What iGEM asks for →

What the model is for

Name the decision the model exists to make. A model that informs nothing wins nothing.

Scope and assumptions

List every assumption as a numbered item, so the sensitivity section can refer to them by number.

Sensing and the light switch

CcaS/CcaR to P_cpcG2. State the transfer function you assume from photon flux to transcription rate, and mark it as assumed.

Borrowed parameter

Roughly 105 minutes to half-maximum is a published value from a different organism at a different wavelength. It is not ours, and the brief records that what it is 105 minutes to half-maximum of is not yet on record.

Expression and translation

Transport across the membrane

This is where the cutoff decision shows up as a number. Run it for both candidate devices.

Parameters

Every parameter, its value, its unit, and its source. Mark ours, borrowed and guessed differently.
